items.title: Supreme Court rejects PIL seeking SIT probe into vote-chori allegations
items.summary: The Supreme Court on Monday rejected a public interest litigation by a lawyer seeking a Special Investigation Team probe into Rahul Gandhi's allegations of anomalies in voter lists (duplicate/invalid entries, e.g. 40,000+ invalid and 10,000+ duplicates cited in Bengaluru's Mahadevapura alone). A bench of CJI Surya Kant and Justice Joymalya Bagchi said a PIL in public interest would not be entertained and the petitioner is at liberty to pursue alternate remedies.

items.title: Full details of INDIA bloc's SC writ petition: 11 named petitioners, alleges ~13 crore voter deletions
items.summary: The day-3 live blog's 6:51 PM IST update names all 11 petitioners on the SIR writ petition filed ~5:16 PM IST: Rahul Gandhi, Mallikarjun Kharge, Akhilesh Yadav, Saugata Roy, Tejashwi Yadav, Sanjay Raut, MA Baby, D Raja, Mahua Majhi, Supriya Sule and ET Mohammed Basheer - versus the ECI, CEC Gyanesh Kumar and ECs Vivek Joshi and Sukhbir Singh Sandhu. The plea alleges large-scale deletion of nearly 13 crore voters during the SIR; its contents are not yet public and the SC is expected to take it up on Tuesday.
